content.comment_body: Can someone clarify the behavior shown in the attached image? In particular: The counter B008 will only increase when Q2 is set to 0 and Q3 is set to 1. Q3 is connected to the Q2 relay coil, suggesting that Q3's relay coil should be processed before Q2's relay logic. If Q3 is 1, and this feeds an OR gate ahead of the Q2 relay coil, then the logic for Q2's relay coil should theoretically not assign a value of 0 to Q2 when Q3 is 1. This scenario occurs in [product_name] Demo, version [version_no], operating within its Simulator. Further details about the application are available at [url].
Please avoid posting the same issue multiple times. You can create your own topic for your problem, such as '[product_name] unexpected behavior'.
Closed because the question was posted twice. The second topic, '[product_name] unexpected behavior', is now public within the '[product_name] - Software' section. Best regards, [user_name]
